The first ready-built version of **inkpainter3d** is here: a free, open-source 3D texture painter for realistic PBR and stylized art. Download, unzip and start it: no installer, no account.

**What it can do**
• Import FBX, glTF and OBJ; every material becomes a texture set
• Paint with pen pressure, brush presets, stencils, symmetry and polygon fill
• A layer stack with paint and fill layers, folders, blend modes and masks
• Generators, color selection, blur and geometry masks in masks
• Bake mesh maps, use smart materials, and get free CC0 materials from ambientCG and Poly Haven right in the shelf
• Save projects and export textures for Blender, Unity (Built-in, URP, HDRP), Godot and glTF

**Download** for Windows, Linux and macOS:
{release}

This is an early version: expect rough edges and keep backups of your projects. On macOS, allow the app on its first start under *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway*.

**Next up:** the projection tool and anchor points. Feedback and bug reports are welcome on GitHub: https://github.com/trueSilentisgold/inkpainter3d/issues
